kb.title: Knowledge base
kb.description: Articles about procedures, with their official source.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Agency information, retention, journey stages and notification templates.
settings.retentionNote: Documents are never permanently deleted without an admin workflow.

rules.title: Document rules
rules.description: Which documents each situation requires. Rules are data: edit them here, no code change is needed.
rules.archived: This version is archived and read-only.
rules.activeWarning: This version is ACTIVE. Changes are audited and apply to cases on this version the next time the engine runs ({n} instance(s) exist).
rules.applicabilityHelp: Conditions are evaluated for each subject (student, sponsor, funding source or application). Without a rule the requirement always applies.
rules.dependenciesHelp: A dependent requirement cannot be completed until its prerequisites are approved.
rules.notHint: true when NOT all conditions below are true
rules.andHint: true when all conditions below are true
rules.orHint: true when at least one condition below is true
rules.alwaysApplicable: No rule: this requirement always applies.
rules.valueHelp: Values: comma-separated for in / not_in / between; param:key refers to a procedure parameter; field:path refers to another field; true / false / numbers are typed automatically.

procedures.title: Procedures
procedures.description: Country → procedure → academic year → version. Cases keep the version they were created with until you migrate them.
procedures.versionNote: Only one version per academic year can be ACTIVE. Drafts do not affect any case.
procedures.confirmActivate: Activate this version? The previous active version of the same academic year is archived.
procedures.diffTitle: Requirement changes if this case is migrated
procedures.keepsDocuments: already has uploaded documents, which stay attached
procedures.name: Name
procedures.valueHint: JSON. Money uses the keys amountMinor (integer minor units) and currency; lists are JSON arrays of strings.
procedures.migrateHelp: Cases on another version of this procedure. Migration is explicit: preview the requirement diff, then confirm. Documents are never deleted.
procedures.noOtherCases: No case is on another version.
procedures.activeWarning: This version is ACTIVE: edits are audited and affect cases on this version.
